annotations.title: DNS lookup for any record type over DNS-over-HTTPS

description: DNS lookup for any record type over DNS-over-HTTPS. Resolve A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR, DS, DNSKEY, HTTPS, SVCB, TLSA or NAPTR records for a name. Returns answers with TTLs, the DNS status and whether DNSSEC validated. TXT strings are joined. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
name: dns_lookup
